_comment: Named cloud sky looks for the Clouds-tab preset picker. Keys are lab_controls.json control ids. RECALIBRATED 2026-06-18 (round 2) to the new weather field (mean ~0.56, large-scale systems) where the coverage knob maps ~directly to sky fill: fill% ~= 132*coverage - 23 (cov 0.32~19%, 0.48~40%, 0.65~63%, 0.75~76%, 0.88~93%). Brightness/ambient tuned against the fixed lighting (premultiplied composite + direct-sun extinction + multi-scatter contrast + 2-octave detail erosion). Stormy = DARK + towering. NOTE: presets drive layer 0 (cumulus) only; full deck-stack driving is roadmap #2.

presets.name: Overcast
presets._layers_note: roadmap #2: Overcast STACKS decks. Layer 0 = knob-driven low stratus (overridden by values above); layers 1-2 add mid stratocumulus + high cirrus. coverage_weight mixes each deck's share of the master coverage knob.

presets.name: God Ray Showcase
presets._comment: Self-contained showcase for the canonical god rays (per-froxel cloud-shadow in global volfog; sun-shadowed in-scatter). Tuned for MAXIMUM shaft visibility: broken cumulus (~0.55 cover = bold cloud shadows + clear gaps), DENSE/OPAQUE clouds so the shadow map has strong gap/cloud contrast (the contrast IS the shaft), a LOW sun (~14°) for a long dramatic rake across the valley, and god rays ON at high strength (drives the sun's volumetric fog energy = shaft brightness). Unlike the weather presets, this also sets the SUN (sun_angle/azimuth/energy) + the god-ray toggle+strength via their control ids, so ONE pick gives perfect conditions. Pair the camera looking roughly toward the sun (azimuth 120°).
